LanguageData.SE_RegenesisSerum.label: regenesis serum
LanguageData.SE_RegenesisSerum.description: A syringe of green fluid containing regenerative mechanites. Once injected, the mechanites induce a deep coma and begin rebuilding old wounds in living tissue. The treatment repairs a permanent injury, but cannot replace a lost limb or organ. Even an uninjured person will remain unconscious until the mechanites finish their work.
LanguageData.SE_AdvancedRegenesisSerum.label: advanced regenesis serum
LanguageData.SE_AdvancedRegenesisSerum.description: A syringe of dense green fluid threaded with dark bioferrite. Its mechanites reconstruct a missing biological body part, or repair an old injury if nothing suitable is missing. Existing artificial replacements are left intact. The reconstruction requires a prolonged coma, and the compound cannot revive the dead.
